689eff8289683ecade09778c.synopsis: After helping her fiancé secure a multi-million-dollar deal, Stella York witnessed him cheating on her with her younger sister, Kim York. The pair brazenly flaunted their affair in front of her, while her grandma and her father pressured her to break off the engagement and surrender her fiancé, Henry Chase, to Kim. In her darkest moment, Stella met Kevin Ford, the young heir of the Ford Group, and the two fell in love at first sight, embarking on a new life together.
689eff8289683ecade09778c.title: Destiny in the Stars

6a06bb6551a5d1e3b304e6a9.synopsis: On her deathbed, Empress Rosa clings to life over an unfulfilled wish, while her three sons ruthlessly vie for the throne. Meanwhile, Celeste arrives to help the Empress. Dismissed by the skeptical princes, Celeste enters the palace, where the dying Empress miraculously revives, kneels, and addresses her as her lady...
6a06bb6551a5d1e3b304e6a9.title: The Empress's Final Wish

6a0d1e90cbe683eabe04f14e.synopsis: Eight months pregnant, Allison Grant lands a $5 million bonus. Joking, she's fired; she gets a vicious slap instead of support. Worse yet: her mother-in-law is drugging her to force a miscarriage, while her husband cheats and plots to steal her fortune. Raging, Allison vows revenge. With her best friend and business partner, she plans a brilliant counterattack, making the traitors pay dearly.
6a0d1e90cbe683eabe04f14e.title: Payout & Payback

6a1cf36a75cb6d05d00f47fb.synopsis: On her eighteenth birthday, Zara finally awakens the power that has been sealed inside her since childhood. For fifteen years, she has lived as a castless servant in House Greth—mocked, controlled, and humiliated by Lord Rowan, the man fate itself chose for her. But when their sacred bond appears, Rowan rejects her in front of the gods and throws her away like she was never worth loving. Then Lord Theron Blackwell arrives. Cold, powerful, and feared by every house in the realm, Theron sees what everyone else refuses to see: Zara is not a servant. She is the missing heir of a destroyed bloodline, the daughter of House Solenne, and the bearer of a divine gift powerful enough to expose every lie in the kingdom. Now Rowan wants her back. Isolde wants her ruined. And the council wants proof. But Zara is done begging for a place in someone else’s world. The rejected girl is about to become the woman every house fears.
6a1cf36a75cb6d05d00f47fb.title: Claimed by the Cursed Kingdom

6a1d30788e3424eb5d018b1b.synopsis: After spending three years suffering as the unwanted “real daughter” of the Davis family, Chloe is drowned by her scheming adopted sister Mia—while her own family rushes past her to save the impostor. Reborn three years earlier, Chloe refuses to be the family doormat again. She cuts ties with the Davises, returns to the only man who ever truly loved her—her adoptive uncle Julian—and rises as a genius hacker, prodigy designer, and the heiress they will all beg to win back.
6a1d30788e3424eb5d018b1b.title: Second Chance No More Mrs. Nice Girl

6a1fe6e094171de24004ffe7.synopsis: Years ago, Jake Hudson entered the Los Angeles business school on a Collins family scholarship. During a fraternity incident, he was rescued by Clair, the eldest daughter of the Collins family, and developed feelings for her. However, a drugging plot led Jake to mistakenly enter Clair's room. To protect the family's reputation, the elder Collins arranged a contract marriage between the two, while secretly entrusting Jake with investigating a traitor within the corporation. During the marriage, Clair misunderstood Jake's scheming nature, becoming cold and distant towards him, even allowing others to humiliate him. Jake, however, remained patient, concealing his feelings, protecting Clair while silently contributing to the corporation. Three years later, Jake, believing he had repaid her debt of gratitude, decided to leave. Only then did Clair realize that Jake was not only not the mastermind behind the poisoning incident but had also made significant contributions to the corporation. Feeling deeply guilty, she began to pursue him. She gradually discovered Jake's resilience and independence, as well as his deep affection for her.
6a1fe6e094171de24004ffe7.title: Too Late, Clair Collins

6a215117e35446e0970e138a.synopsis: The day Rose gives birth, she discovers her husband Tyler and protégée Sarah have been having an affair—and have just swapped her newborn daughter for their illegitimate son, leaving her real baby to die in the rain. Rose rescues her daughter in secret and spends the next two decades raising her into a billionaire heiress, while quietly playing the doting “mother” to the impostor child. When her revenge finally lands, no one will be left standing.
6a215117e35446e0970e138a.title: Divorce Me？Bow to My Billionaire Daughter!

6a223050fd137dd5ef0e3675.synopsis: Three hundred years ago, Evelyn, the Supreme Witch, sealed the Demon King Lucifer in the underworld and reincarnated as Ivy, an orphan with feeble spiritual power. Seventeen years later, Lucifer’s minions infiltrated Silver Thorn Academy, plotting to awaken the Demon King through a dark magic circle. After enrolling in the academy, Ivy formed fateful bonds with Kane, the Alpha Werewolf, Sebastian, the Vampire Patriarch, and Victor, the Demon Hunter Mentor — the three chosen guardians of the demon core. Lucifer set a trap to kill Ivy before her power awakened, but it instead triggered her dormant supreme abilities. Heirs of the three great clans joined forces to fight the Demon King, and Ivy, regaining her full power, banished Lucifer back to the abyss once more.
6a223050fd137dd5ef0e3675.title: Bound to My Three Fated High Lords

6a22350b86a8394e370207ff.synopsis: Back from seclusion, cultivator Leonard stuns the internet—joining his live-streamer great-granddaughter to show off real magic!
6a22350b86a8394e370207ff.title: Immortal Grandpa Goes Viral!

6a2b68ac6fff4c90380cdae9.synopsis: The star superhero Bryan left his gravely injured secret wife Rachel to die in an explosion for better publicity. After sacrificing her career for their hidden marriage for 5 years, a devastated Rachel underwent agonizing genetic experiments in Vought’s Aurora Project. Reinvented as the first female superhero Lumina, she erased her former identity completely. All Bryan had left was her death certificate, doomed to gaze up at the woman he threw away.
6a2b68ac6fff4c90380cdae9.title: You'll Regret Cheating on a Superhero

6a338e275fc1c89a8f035c19.synopsis: Her stepmother sold her off for a dowry—but sent her to the wrong address. She ended up in a drugged lawyer's bed, fled in anger, and never looked back. Nine months later, she walks into his firm for a divorce lawyer. He's been searching for her ever since.
6a338e275fc1c89a8f035c19.title: The Lawyer She Slept With

6a3ddc7b6c8a0267ae0408ca.synopsis: Aria risked her life to enter the brutal War Academy for her boyfriend, only to find him in the arms of another woman. Devastated and betrayed, a moment of reckless anger leads her into a dangerous encounter with Blaze Blackwood—the ruthless Alpha King and her academy's Chief Proctor. Unbeknownst to Aria, Blaze is also her cheating ex's formidable father. After a passionate and accidental night together, Aria is horrified to discover she is pregnant. Trapped in an elite academy where she is mocked as a "Wolfless Omega," Aria must survive deadly trials, jealous rivals, and the terrifying presence of the Alpha King who refuses to let her go. Will she succumb to the powerful pull between them, or will her hidden secrets and their forbidden connection destroy them both?
6a3ddc7b6c8a0267ae0408ca.title: Knocked Up by My Ex's Alpha Daddy

6a45c77e2fdd0135260e2dea.synopsis: Alex Carter is humiliated when his girlfriend Eva dumps him on a livestream for Brandon, a flashy rich boy with a Lamborghini. But at his lowest moment, a mysterious system binds itself to Leah, his sharp-tongued roommate and luxury real estate agent. Every emotional reaction she has because of Alex triggers huge rewards. With Leah by his side, Alex buys a McLaren, luxury properties, rare gems, a nightclub and casino shares. As Eva regrets leaving too soon and Brandon's fake wealth collapses, Alex rises from broke delivery driver to capital power player.
6a45c77e2fdd0135260e2dea.title: The Day You Dumped Me, I Became a Millionaire

6a45cd5d6a8c4720d70d7bf9.synopsis: Aria Vale spent three years pretending to be the perfect housewife for Damon Crawford, the man who thought he built his Wall Street empire alone. Then he brought home a mistress and demanded an open marriage. Aria smiled and said yes. One call later, New York’s richest men were at her feet, ruthless Kade Ashford claimed her in public, and every hidden Vale dollar vanished from Damon’s company. By the time he learned his “boring wife” was the heiress funding him, bankruptcy, divorce, and lifelong regret were already waiting.
6a45cd5d6a8c4720d70d7bf9.title: The Housewife He Threw Away Is a Billionaire

6a471408082122dc360d635c.synopsis: Stella was LA royalty until her father's fraud charge ended in suicide, and her fiancé left. She spite-seduced his uncle, billionaire Nicholas. Her mother's stroke sent her back; he put her to work at his bar. Contract became closeness, closeness became taboo love, and a pregnancy raised the stakes. His probe into her father's death exposed a plot aimed at the Archer empire.
6a471408082122dc360d635c.title: Your Uncle Is Obsessed with Me

6a5062a2cfe82f6004003dad.synopsis: My husband drowned me while I was pregnant, calling me nothing more than a gold-digging maid. When I opened my eyes, I was back before the nightmare began. This time, I refused to become his mistress. Instead, I climbed into the bed of the one man he could never defeat—his billionaire adoptive father. “You're mine now,” Marcus said. I thought I was only using him for revenge... until the day my ex knelt before us in tears, and I realized I'd fallen for the only man who had ever truly protected me.
6a5062a2cfe82f6004003dad.title: I Seduced My Husband’s Adoptive Father

6a55ac24485f9d5b0506785a.title: Dying After Ten Years for His Sin

6a55d7c500cd6e27a200316a.synopsis: Aurora Pyrelyn dies with her black drake husband Rowan’s claws in her chest, only to wake on the day of their Soulflame Bond. This time, Rowan remembers too, and he chooses Aurora’s golden sister Celeste for the throne she was promised. But Aurora no longer begs for a love built on ambition. She gives Rowan away, chooses the mocked white dragon Silas Frost, and discovers his vow is the one loyalty she was always denied. As Celeste, Rowan, and Aurora’s father chase bloodline power, the Old Flame Law reveals its truth: Aurora is not the heir, but the one who chooses who deserves the Throneflame. Betrayed again, she takes back her stolen fire, breaks the old bloodline order, and flies free with the dragon who chose her first.
6a55d7c500cd6e27a200316a.title: The Black Drakes Second Vow

6a56e53710cf0d2533014cfd.synopsis: Before I left for the Rogue Wars, my best friend Selene made me memorize one warning: if I ever came home and saw her eating almonds, that woman was not her. Three months later, I returned to Blood Moon Pack and found the Luna smiling at the dinner table, chewing the one food that should have killed her. Same face. Same scent. Same memories. She even called me by our childhood nickname. But Selene had never given false warnings. If the woman in front of me was not her, then where was my real Luna?
6a56e53710cf0d2533014cfd.title: The Silent Luna’s Secret

6a56e53a4ffb908818071aad.synopsis: New York's two deadliest queenpins, Vera Marchetti and Bianca Conti, have been rivals for twenty years and lovers in secret. When Bianca is exposed as a fake heiress, stripped of her name, and thrown to the enemies she made for her family, Vera flies home to claim the only person allowed to kill her. Together they turn a blood debt into a power play, crush the Contis, and make the underworld watch its most dangerous enemies become wives.
6a56e53a4ffb908818071aad.title: Queenpins- My Enemy, My Wife

6a5840e82769ac7896097974.synopsis: My best friend died with an Ivy League acceptance in one hand... and a billionaire heir's secrets in the other. So I reinvented myself as a Silicon Valley heiress and started dating the man who destroyed her. His family mocked me, used me, and treated me like their personal ATM. I smiled through every insult—because I was collecting evidence. But when I overheard them plotting to drug me, get me pregnant, and steal my fortune... the hunt officially began.
6a5840e82769ac7896097974.title: The Fake Heiress's Revenge

6a5d836dda4a556288063f1e.synopsis: My boyfriend Carter body-shamed me and paid me to get a breast reduction. I posted online to find a new guy, only to chat with his cold best friend Jude. He bought back my late dad’s bracelet and wired me 1.43 million. At his birthday party, I learned Carter got another girl pregnant. When I flew to surprise Jude at his hotel, I caught him with a woman clinging to his arm—was he just another liar?
6a5d836dda4a556288063f1e.title: Hook With Boyfriend's Best Friend

6a5d83c2142a64de2f0f292d.synopsis: Three years ago, Elena Vance was humiliated on her wedding day when her husband, Tristan, brought his pregnant mistress and forced her to sign divorce papers. That night, Elena disappeared and married Adrian Blackwood, the most feared Mafia Don on the East Coast. Now pregnant with Adrian’s second child, she returns to Edenport, only to be slapped by Tristan, who thinks she is pretending to be Mrs. Blackwood. When Chloe crushes Elena’s black onyx signet ring at a gala, Adrian arrives with their son. One word exposes everything: “Mommy.” Now the city will learn who Elena really is.
6a5d83c2142a64de2f0f292d.title: The Mafia Don's Secret Wife

6a6975bf5d8851c89d0fcc8d.synopsis: Sophie grew up in an orphanage and was adopted by the wealthy Johnson family at the age of six. She spent twelve happy years under the love of her three elder brothers and adoptive parents. However, when her adoptive parents' biological daughter, Camille, returned, Sophie fell from being the cherished gem to a misunderstood and hurt outsider. Camille maneuvered step by step, constantly framing Sophie, while the family chose to listen selectively, and the repeated coldness and hurt left her disheartened. Sophie decided to become the first volunteer for her elder brother's 'Sleep Project,' which had been planned for five years, repaying her adoptive parents’ kindness through a life experiment. On her eighteenth birthday, she severed all ties with her family, entered the sleep chamber alone, and donated her corneas to her blind second brother. When she awoke after thirty years of slumber, her family had grown old, but she could no longer remember them—leaving only that misplaced familial affection, etched as an eternal regret through the river of time.
6a6975bf5d8851c89d0fcc8d.title: My Freeze. Their Tears. No Forgiveness

6a6b01dc39f964ed56043895.synopsis: Three years ago, rising star Danny lost everything after being betrayed by the two people he trusted most. Everyone believed he was gone for good. Now he's back with a new identity and a carefully planned revenge. His target? The ex-lover who destroyed his life and the best friend who helped cover it up. But things take an unexpected turn when he crosses paths with Allen, the younger brother of the man he hates most. What starts as a dangerous game soon becomes something neither of them can control. As old secrets resurface and feelings grow stronger, Danny must decide, finish his revenge, or risk everything for the one person he never meant to love.
6a6b01dc39f964ed56043895.title: Revenge in My Ex's Brother's Bed

6a7006698a1b1823640e172f.synopsis: Evelyn, a senior purser at Atlantic Airways, is reborn with intact memories of her previous life. Drawing on her foreknowledge, she sees through the deadly murder plot hatched by her husband and her trusted best friend. At an altitude of 30,000 feet, she turns the tide against all odds and saves the heir to the Sterling family. After being wrongfully framed and later fully exonerated, she secures the patronage of the Sterling family and is parachuted into the airline’s corporate headquarters. Leveraging her elite risk management expertise, she dismantles the conspiracies of her long-standing career arch-rivals, and ultimately ascends to the absolute pinnacle of power in the aviation industry.
6a7006698a1b1823640e172f.title: Reborn: A Flight Attendant Counterattack

6a7047879dbba6268204e157.synopsis: Sera, the scorned Siren princess of Atlantis, is forced by fate to serve Ares ninety-nine times for an old rescue. The war god thinks she is a shameless worshipper, making her dance on bleeding feet, crawl before Aphrodite, and nearly drown for a false crime. But every humiliation cracks the contract. When Sera finally repays the debt, she returns to the deep sea as royalty. Only then does Ares learn she was his true savior, his obsession, and the princess he can never own again.
6a7047879dbba6268204e157.title: 99 Cracks：The Scorned Siren’s Final Goodbye

6a82754b603b5c0ffa02aeb6.synopsis: After losing his eldest son Ethan to murder, billionaire Kane Morgan retreated from the spotlight and became a ride-hail driver to quietly watch over his younger son Liam. At a welcome party, Liam is humiliated by Damian—and discovers his late brother's fiancée is having an affair with him. Then Liam is kidnapped and learns Ethan was tortured to death by Damian. Just as Damian sets up a cruel game to torment Liam, Kane smashes through the door. His old subordinate Victor arrives and bows in submission. The kidnappers realize the taxi driver was a top-tier capital magnate all along. Kane declares revenge, returns to Vertex Capital, and launches an all-out assault on the O'Hara empire. Victor punishes his own son Taylor. Vanessa's repentance is too late. After these trials, Liam reconciles with his father. Together they run the conglomerate. Liam and Aurora fall deeply in love. The O'Hara Group collapses completely.
6a82754b603b5c0ffa02aeb6.title: Don’t Provoke Him，He’s the King of L.A

6a83b89dd41c248dae056469.synopsis: In Mafia Queen's Fake Bride movie, FBI Agent Parker is assigned a covert mission: go undercover as the heiress to a mafia family and become the bride at a gangster wedding. But before she walks down the aisle, the groom is a no-show—and in his place stands his older sister, Thea: the old flame Parker coldly killed on an undercover assignment three years ago.
6a83b89dd41c248dae056469.title: Mafia Queen's Fake Bride

6a83eecc862e4975f202e3b3.synopsis: After three years in the hands of the Black Raven pirates, Evelyn returns to find Arthur beside another woman and unwilling to believe her wounds. With poison already in her bones, she gathers rings, ledgers, confessions, and witnesses to expose Vera, destroy Black Raven, and rescue the girls still trapped at sea. When truth finally arrives too late, Evelyn wakes again as a child and chooses a future far from the man who failed her.
6a83eecc862e4975f202e3b3.title: Rose drowned in the Kuroshio Current

6a8514607074043629031bdb.synopsis: Housewife Renee suffers from a long-term sexless marriage because her husband Ethan favors her older sister Kira. This repression triggers a compulsive sexual disorder, and she seeks medical help in shame, where she meets Damian—a elite professional with a double identity. In the consultation room, he sees through her pain and childhood family trauma. Using treatment as a pretext, he gets close to her, then unexpectedly joins her company as her new boss and promotes her to be his personal assistant. In public, he is restrained; in private, the tension between them is electric. Renee is repeatedly humiliated by her husband and framed—drugged and kidnapped by her sister—but Damian fiercely protects her at every turn, dismantling their enemies' power. Renee decisively divorces, and after a crisis involving a doppelgänger impersonating her, the two finally confess their true feelings and hold a wedding. In the end, Renee becomes pregnant. They heal each other's traumas, and she gains both a flourishing career and a fulfilling family.
6a8514607074043629031bdb.title: Addicted to My CEO Doctor

6a8544182f75b2fba60697a9.synopsis: "To save his terminally ill younger brother, impoverished basketball prodigy Anderson accidentally wanders into the private testing lab of wealthy heir Campbell. Forced to sign an exclusive, high-value contract, he finds himself trapped in a series of bizarre physical compatibility tests. Convinced he's completely straight, Anderson is repeatedly betrayed by his own body's honest reactions, believing he's fallen into an attraction he never asked for. What he doesn't know is that Campbell, who originally intended nothing more than to tame and control him, is gradually losing control himself. Captivated by Anderson's untamed spirit and fierce resistance, the hunter slowly becomes the one being conquered."
6a8544182f75b2fba60697a9.title: Came For The Money, Stayed For Him

6a8670cba86ffc1fac0c417e.synopsis: Evelyn, heir to the Crimson Moon Pack, once trusted her three Alpha fiancés completely, only to discover they were manipulating her for Mia—a fragile Omega who is secretly an enemy spy. Blinded by Mia's lies, the Alphas repeatedly crush Eve with their dominance. In her darkest hour, Eve’s ancient Moon Queen bloodline awakens, drawing Kyle, a top Alpha who has guarded her in secret for years. Kyle rescues her and seals their bond. At her mating ceremony, Eve publicly rejects the three Alphas and chooses Kyle. The spy is exposed and destroyed, leaving the three Alphas in eternal regret while Eve and Kyle claim the throne.
6a8670cba86ffc1fac0c417e.title: Three Alphas Abandoned Me for that Omega, Then Regretted It

6a86742ccad37e54ae051a18.synopsis: My Alpha husband just woke from a five-year coma... and I'm pregnant with his brother's baby. He still calls me his mate, still believes I spent five years waiting for him. He doesn't know he rejected me, broke our bond, and lost me forever. Now the only thing more dangerous than my secret marriage is the child growing inside me. What happens when he finally learns whose Luna I really am?
6a86742ccad37e54ae051a18.title: Rejected By The Alpha, Claimed By His Brother

6a86749ff52297f7020402cf.synopsis: After Dante Conti let his mistress Selena Russo torment their six-year-old daughter Sofia, Isabella Moretti fought back and was locked inside Ashford Sanitarium. Years later, Dante forced her to sign away her rights with Sofia’s urn as a threat, believing he had broken her forever. But Sicily turned the abandoned wife into Don Moretti. Backed by Luca Ricci, the Don of Palermo, and the hidden power of her father Vittorio, Isabella returns to New York’s Five Families banquet to expose Selena’s lies, reclaim her empire, and make Dante watch the Conti throne collapse for every drop of blood he spilled.
6a86749ff52297f7020402cf.title: Blood Oaths and Broken Thrones

6a86cb6b65d0fbfc9a011c55.synopsis: After defeating Pope Pari in a contest of strength, Percy wins his approval—but declines the papacy to search for his origins. Guided by the Pope, he arrives in Crow Territory, rescues his sister, and reaches the Cohen family, only to find them under siege by the Ross family. His mother reveals the truth of his birth and urges him to flee. Moved, Percy defeats the invaders Brienne and Fiona, and encounters Mia of the Outflow Church, who has been searching for him. Brienne and Fiona are rescued and transformed by the fallen mage Cru. Fiona evolves into an evil dragon. Percy is defeated and nearly killed. Mia saves him at the cost of her own life. Percy awakens the Sun God's blessing, heals Mia, transforms into a seraph, and slays Fiona. Cru flees. Percy returns Mia to the Church, refuses the papacy again, and chooses to hunt down Cru.
6a86cb6b65d0fbfc9a011c55.title: Abandoned by the Duke, I'm the Divine Seraph

6a86dc2e175020bfa6012415.synopsis: A hundred years ago, Thalen the Sea God saved the Maris Sea from monsters and a prophesied tsunami. Kael, saved by him, received an Oath Emblem that could grant any wish. A century later, the sea citadel faces ruin. Dying Kael summons Thalen to form a three-year soul bond with his granddaughter Serena to protect their clan. Thalen hides his divine identity, marries into the family as a blacksmith, and silently sustains the Sea Barrier—but Serena sees him as a disgrace. When noble Lord Cedric returns, he steals Thalen's achievements, frames him for treason, and claims credit. Blindly believing Cedric, Serena demands the bond be broken. Thalen agrees without protest and withdraws his power. The divine runes on the barrier fade—and the apocalyptic tsunami finally arrives, as the whole truth is about to break.
6a86dc2e175020bfa6012415.title: My Worthless Ex-Husband Is Poseidon, God of the Sea

6a87ae87c2e5e6251000097d.synopsis: Cursed by the Moon Goddess, Alpha werewolf Arthur Griffin has only one way to survive: before his 30th birthday, he must find the one person bearing the Moon Mark—the legendary Pure Vessel—and complete their fated bond. Otherwise, he will die. For years, Arthur has searched every corner of the country, but his quest has led nowhere. Convinced that his destined mate must be a woman, he never once questioned the prophecy. Everything changes after a tragic car accident brings an unexpected young man into his life. The moment Arthur discovers the hidden Moon Mark on the young man's waist, he realizes the shocking truth— The fated mate he has spent ten years searching for... is a man. Desperate to break his curse and stay alive, Arthur will stop at nothing to keep the young man by his side. But what begins as a relationship built on obsession, possession, and resistance gradually transforms into a love neither of them can escape—a love that was written by fate from the very beginning.
6a87ae87c2e5e6251000097d.title: The Cursed Alpha and His Virgin Groom

6a87afcf0641e2829b07bd3d.synopsis: At the engagement banquet, the Dark Lord Darius lifted my veil, his eyes filled with disgust. “The woman I wanted to marry is dead. Yet you are still alive.” He blindfolded me, forbidding me to speak, forbidding me to raise my head. That night, I cried away all the tears of my past life. Reborn, I returned to the day he mistook someone else for the one who had saved him. My sister Elise was pretending to be me, accepting his marriage contract in my place. This time, I knelt before the Duchess first. “Please, Madam, arrange my marriage as soon as possible too.” Later, I married the northern Frost Lord, a man infamous for his cold-blooded cruelty. On the day of my wedding, Darius fought his way to my bridal carriage.
6a87afcf0641e2829b07bd3d.title: The Vampire Lord’s Final Salvation

6a87b49aae487843a005c104.synopsis: Emily marries Ronan Walker, but divorces him after discovering his affair with Vivian Hart. She returns to acting to regain independence and meets Ronan's friend William. Amid conflicts, the truth emerges. When Ronan is injured saving Emily, they reconcile and rekindle their love, starting anew.
6a87b49aae487843a005c104.title: Mr. Walker, Your Ex-Wife is Your Boss

6a881516109908ce810c1ce6.synopsis: Once overweight and insecure, Zheng Xiumin is bullied by heiress Kang Yoo-jin at work and pushed off a rooftop to her death. Reborn as orphan Han So-eun, she is granted a "Heart Points Exchange System" that rewards her for winning others' affection. With her mesmerizing voice, she lands a job at an exclusive private club and systematically seduces Kang Yoo-jin's arranged fiancé, her standby suitor, her cousin, and her junior—each conquest earning points that gradually transform her appearance and physique. Using the influence of these four wealthy men, she tears off Kang's mask of hypocrisy, exposes her crimes of assault and oppression, sabotages Sejin Group's partnerships, and forces Kang into overseas "recovery." In the end, the heroine lets go of her bitterness, finds companionship with those she has redeemed, and achieves both self-salvation and total revenge.
6a881516109908ce810c1ce6.title: Rose of Seoul: Revenge Reborn

6a8ba21210ae054ece06c2a7.synopsis: Four years ago, Taylor Marchetti waited in the rain while the man she'd loved since sixteen chose a Russo heiress and two seats at the Syndicate Table over her. That same night, she wrote to the Northern Chapter and honored the marriage her dead father had arranged — to Jax Logan, the youngest Head Enforcer the Syndicate has ever had, and the most dangerous. Now she's back in the South, luggage lost, dressed like nobody, and they all assume she's crawled home broke. Jude mocks her. Cora tears the wedding ring off her hand and wears it to four Chapter parties. Nobody thinks to ask whose wife she is. They're about to find out. And so is Taylor — because the reason Jax married her goes back ten years, to a freezing night, a blanket, and a girl who was thirteen and kind to a stranger.
6a8ba21210ae054ece06c2a7.title: My Husband Runs the Syndicate

6a8ba2809c6562e0640a54e7.synopsis: The alien bugs invaded, and humanity retreated to the "Ark" mobile fortress. Four years ago, hero Kevin piloted the mech "Silver Scar" to defeat the swarm, but retired after his entire squad fell. When the bugs returned, Kevin reapplied—only to show 0% compatibility. Spy Marshal Sam framed him for treason, sentenced him to death, and sent his mech to the scrapyard. As the swarm breached the gates and Kevin faced execution, "Silver Scar" self-activated, rescued him, and synced at 100%. Kevin repelled the swarm, and the whole city witnessed the war god's return.
6a8ba2809c6562e0640a54e7.title: Displaced War God

6a8ba4d32c15011e540b072b.synopsis: Tessa’s crush throws her cinnamon roll in the trash and calls her a fat pig in front of the whole class. When she finally stops begging to be chosen, she starts glowing up and catches everyone’s eye, including the boy who destroyed her. But Tessa has already chosen Adrian, the masked outcast everyone calls scarred and pathetic. By the time Chase wants her back, Adrian’s secret is out: he was never weak. He was the richest, most dangerous boy in the room.
6a8ba4d32c15011e540b072b.title: The Girl They Regretted Losing

6a8ba4d95da2c9a5c50c17f9.synopsis: "No one helps her. Let her burn." My husband said those words while I was trapped inside a burning car—with a steel bar through my chest. Then my phone somehow connected to him... four years in the past. The boy who once begged me to marry him watched me die while the man he became refused to save me. He thinks I'm lying. He doesn't know I'm carrying his baby... or that this is the last time he'll ever hear my voice.
6a8ba4d95da2c9a5c50c17f9.title: THE DON LET ME BURN

6a8ba956743331814f0d4827.synopsis: Winnie once gave up her dream of becoming a doctor for her family, only to be taken for granted by her husband, Owen. Reborn in the 1980s, she refuses to repeat her past. She divorces Owen and heads to Hillwood to pursue brain tumor research. Only after losing her does Owen realize her worth and begin a long journey to win her back. But Winnie is no longer willing to sacrifice herself for love. She devotes herself to medicine, helps drive major breakthroughs, and builds a life of her own.
6a8ba956743331814f0d4827.title: Reborn in the '80s, I Chose Science Over Love

6a8babd69828929ab10d315a.synopsis: Devoting 50 years to her husband meant nothing when Emily discovered his heart belonged to another. Reborn in the '70s with her college letter in hand, she rips up their marriage deal. Leaving romance behind, she sets off to build her own legacy. He's history now.
6a8babd69828929ab10d315a.title: Reborn in the 70s: For Country, Not Love

6a8bafeb4c31fef2aa0c1467.synopsis: Ethan Sterling seems like a loser. But in reality, he has hit the Great Emperor realm. All he wants is a peaceful life. Too bad the Outer Lands Evil Race attacks. Forced to act, he and his disciples have to repel the enemies, which exposes his whereabouts. Then his pet rooster, Rocco, is taken by the Golden Crow Race. Now Ethan has to take more challenges.
6a8bafeb4c31fef2aa0c1467.title: My Strongest Master Pretends to Be Weak 2

6a8bb7b6c922d6c26505cd8b.synopsis: Ten days married, and her husband dumps her. She's hunted in the woods. Until she saves a wild, memory-less man and marries him. But he's actually the murderous Wolf King who woke up one hundred year ago. And her? She's the sealed Supreme Duke of Hell. When her ex and his mistress humiliate her, their bloodlines awaken. Extreme revenge. Forbidden desire. Together they crush every traitor and make them crawl at their feet.
6a8bb7b6c922d6c26505cd8b.title: Possessed by the Alpha No Escape

6a8cf7fca29b9799aa03db2c.synopsis: Aria hides her identity as the sole heiress of America's richest family and enters college disguised as a scholarship student to evaluate her arranged fiancé. Instead, she becomes the target of a cruel dating game where wealthy students compete to break girls' hearts for money. She plays along until the night they publicly dump and humiliate her. Just when everyone expects tears, Aria ends the game with a single phone call. Their fortunes, reputations, and futures begin collapsing one by one. But the revenge she prepared is far from over.
6a8cf7fca29b9799aa03db2c.title: They Bet on My Tears

6a8d515010f3a4bb8309dad3.synopsis: Orion, the Lord of the Tides, sacrificed his soul to seal the Ancient Sea Beasts, losing his memories and divine power. After years of living as a fool, he finds love with Alice. But when she is forced to marry the pirate lord Harry, Orion awakens the power of the Lord of the Tides. How will he win his wife back?
6a8d515010f3a4bb8309dad3.title: Splash! The Lord of the Tides Comes Roaring Back

6a8e4aa6ebe437ec9c0a4834.synopsis: Aria has served vampire lord Alexander as his thrall for three years. He forgets their blood oath renewal night for his new lover Carmilla, leaving Aria to a lethal curse. Aria turns to Prince Cassius, who saves her from drowning with a bonding kiss. Alexander, regretful, abducts her and forces a wedding. Imprisoned by his father, Cassius breaks free, objects at the altar, and defeats Alexander. Alexander gets 800 years in prison, Carmilla is banished, and Cassius reveals Aria was his mate long before their bond began.
6a8e4aa6ebe437ec9c0a4834.title: Blood and Roses: Tears of a Vampire

6a8e902f9185ccf2230990ab.synopsis: Leon Vance, Son of Zeus, disappeared in the disaster 10 years ago. His daughter Beryl blames him for her mom's death —— a wound that time has only deepened. Now back as janitor, he hides his power to protect his little girl, and endures her cold stares and mockery. But when Lord of Abyss descends once more, the world is stunned to discover that the coward janitor is their almighty savior.
6a8e902f9185ccf2230990ab.title: Wrath of Zeus's Son 2: Secret Protection from the Janitor

6a8fce5a72320f50d207cd12.synopsis: Former beauty queen Wendy thought marrying into the Carter family was her fairy-tale ending, only to discover it was a living nightmare. Her husband Jonathan sees her only as his "No. 113 collectible" and is secretly having an affair with her sister-in-law, Chloe. Betrayed and belittled, Wendy refuses to suffer in silence. Armed with an IVF pregnancy and a strategically swapped piece of underwear, she ignites a path of calculated revenge. Teaming up with Sean, her husband's scorned illegitimate brother, she exposes Jonathan's litany of sins at the climax of the family's farewell banquet. Just when everyone believes she is only fighting for a divorce, Wendy reveals her true fangs—she demands not just her freedom, but for the entire Carter dynasty to pay for their arrogance.
6a8fce5a72320f50d207cd12.title: The Day of Betrayal, I Took Everything

6a900bc7e259af77060af16c.synopsis: Reborn as an Immortal Venerable, Tristan returns to rewrite fate itself. After crushing a deadly illusion and rebuilding his clan, he learns a shocking truth: his mother never died of illness. Behind her death stands a powerful family in the imperial capital. As he heads to Southshire, old mysteries resurface—and this time, nothing will stop him.
6a900bc7e259af77060af16c.title: I Am the Immortal Lord Season 2

6a9034ce5284d484dd043333.synopsis: For centuries, Pale Wraith has been trapped in a graveyard, visible only to a girl named Gianna. Gianna feeds the lonely spirit for years, and they form a deep bond until she marries and disappears. Pale Wraith waits, only to see Gianna's children return to bury their mother. Refusing to let her story end, Pale Wraith takes over Gianna's body, avenges her death, raises her children, and transforms the lives of women throughout the village, earning the name Lady Pale Wraith.
6a9034ce5284d484dd043333.title: Lady Pale Wraith

6a90e77f3400f6ce3b0fad07.synopsis: Framed by the deceitful adopted daughter Eleanor, Matilda suffered three years of unbearable torment in a dark monastery. Returning home with deep scars and a branded heart, she found only cold violence from her cruel father and blind brother. Cutting all tied blood bonds, Matilda chooses to marry Killian—a seemingly wild, disgraced prince. But behind his reckless guise lies an unwavering loyalty. When her past burns open and long-buried secrets unravel, the vicious imposter is unmasked, and her family is crushed by brutal regret. Matilda steps out of the ashes, no longer a victim, but a queen.
6a90e77f3400f6ce3b0fad07.title: The Branded Witch is the Prince's Bride

6a90ebe987b0c61f9007735c.synopsis: Elara, an 18-year-old painter, wakes up ten years in the future as her 28-year-old self, discovering she is married to a billionaire and has a 4-year-old son. Facing an impending divorce and a fate of dying on the streets within a year, she must repair her relationship with her husband Soren in just one month. At the same time, she has to deal with Damian, a fake lover who has long been posing as a wealthy man and draining her finances, as well as her ruthless stepmother-in-law, who is scheming to seize the family fortune. Amid the chaotic and dramatic life of the wealthy elite, Elara relies on her 18-year-old wit and straightforwardness to gradually uncover the truth behind her parents' death and make her husband fall in love with her all over again—with this "new" soul.
6a90ebe987b0c61f9007735c.title: Transmigrated as a Billionaire's Wife

6a912471533d191e1d0a5726.synopsis: Brynna’s fiancé, Sterling, crashes their wedding with his wealthy mistress, Celina. In front of everyone, they set fire to the wedding dress designs she spent months creating and viciously humiliate her elderly mother. Enraged by their cruelty, her mother suffers a fatal heart attack and dies on the spot. Overnight, Brynna loses her fiancé, her career, and the only family she has left. Heartbroken, she leaves the country. Five years later, Brynna makes a stunning return to the fashion world with her daughter, Mia, and her mysterious “contract husband,” Kane. At a major fashion exhibition, Sterling claims Mia is his daughter. He and Celina publicly slap Brynna and try to snatch the child from her. Just when Brynna is about to lose everything again, Kane steps forward to protect them and reveals his true identity.He is one of Europe’s most powerful financial tycoons. In front of the entire crowd, he declares Brynna his legal wife and Mia his biological daughter. Sterling’s exhibition privileges are immediately revoked.Everyone thinks Brynna has finally turned the tables.But the real revenge has only just begun. And when the dust finally settles, what will become of the contract marriage that has lasted five years?
6a912471533d191e1d0a5726.title: My Kids Ruin My Ex's Fancy Life

6a9666af470904d5580f098e.synopsis: For ten years, Evelyn helped Stephen rise from fallen prince to emperor, protecting him and bearing his two children. She thought their love would last forever until he married her sister. Heartbroken, Evelyn activated her system and returned to the modern world. Only after she vanished did Stephen and their children realize what they'd lost, crossing a thousand years to beg her back. But Evelyn is done being anyone's consort or mother. This time, she chooses herself.
6a9666af470904d5580f098e.title: Your Consort Is Back in the Modern World

6a97bb7b5edcbfc5b9067696.synopsis: Though blind, Lyra has an incredible gift: she can understand the language of spirit beasts. Then she starts bonding with adorable spirit pets and gathers a group of steadfast companions. Using her kindness and wit, she calms the beast tides!
6a97bb7b5edcbfc5b9067696.title: I Calm the Beast Tides With Spirit‑Words

6a98068fa11efb8684067d36.synopsis: To pay off her father’s debts, Diana Banning unexpectedly shares an intimate night with billionaire CEO Ethan Vance and ends up marrying him out of guilt and obligation. She is determined to fulfill her dream of being a designer, yet she winds up with an overly clingy, jealous husband.An ex-boyfriend, a young female rival chasing Ethan Vance, and an imposter pretending to be the CEO’s wife keep stirring up trouble. Ethan Vance fakes illness to hold her close while fiercely standing up for her against anyone who dares to hurt her. A hilarious, heart-fluttering tug-of-war filled with love and jealousy kicks off!
6a98068fa11efb8684067d36.title: Moonlit Wilds, A Secret Yearning

6a981a168259296cb909cc7d.synopsis: At Cascadia Reptile Research Institute, Noah Hayes is assigned to Avery, the largest and most bad-tempered white python in the facility. Avery refuses food, scares away every snake Noah cares for, bites only him, and keeps wrapping around him like a jealous lover. Noah thinks the snake hates him, until a breeding-season check reveals the ridiculous truth: Avery has been courting him all along. When Avery starts leaving “gifts,” guarding him from other snakes, and appearing in Noah’s dreams as a beautiful silver-haired man, Noah realizes his troublesome white snake may want far more than care. He wants Noah.
6a981a168259296cb909cc7d.title: My Black Python Wants My Eggs

6a9a76ca38999d12c103c839.synopsis: In the ancient Greek era, when gods ruled the heavens and the earth, a single pure love — steadfast for five long years — stood against the prejudice and malice of the entire world, weaving a tale of redemption between god and mortal. Elena, a fallen noble girl, endured mockery and family pressure without flinching. For five years, she held on — never wavering, never abandoning Aether, a man with a broken mind. Her family, eager to climb the social ladder, forced her into marriage with Drakon, an ambitious temple priest. On the eve of the wedding, the two bid each other a painful farewell — only to be cruelly ambushed by Drakon. Aether was mortally wounded, teetering on the brink of death. In that desperate hour, Aether awakened the primordial origin of the Chaos God — a power sealed for ten thousand years. The supreme divine force that once towered above all the heavens surged back to life. The once-submissive mortal transformed into a ruthless sovereign of the divine realm. To protect the one he loved, he defied the odds, overturned their fate, and rewrote their destiny with his own hands.
6a9a76ca38999d12c103c839.title: The God They Called a Fool

6a9e50f2f0b3ac02d102ff76.synopsis: He is the only Omega in the entire military camp, crushing every Alpha with perfect scores just to join the legendary team Raven and stand beside his idol, Ares Thorn. But on the day he earns his place, the man waiting for him is not Ares. It is Logan Frost, an ace sniper and the legal husband assigned to him by the matching system, kneeling before him with roses in his hands. Before Ethan can refuse, Ares steps out from behind Logan, grips Ethan's chin in front of everyone, and says, "He is mine." His idol claims him. His husband proposes. On the same day. As the countdown to his forced match closes in and enemy fire surrounds them, Ethan realizes he never wanted only to stand beside Ares. He wants far more than that. He does not want to become anyone's Omega. He wants to become Raven.
6a9e50f2f0b3ac02d102ff76.title: The Omega's Command

6a9e5e483e3e3774520ffddd.synopsis: Careless father leaves toddler in a hot car unattended. Will her mother be able to find her and save her in time?
6a9e5e483e3e3774520ffddd.title: Daddy Left His Baby to Die

6aa75787742a9765a10bfc80.synopsis: On the same day, two best friends gave birth. Ellen, drowning in poverty, secretly swapped her newborn with her billionaire best friend’s baby, desperate to give her daughter a life of luxury. What she never expected: her friend saw everything and silently switched the babies back. Eighteen years later, just as Ellen’s scheme is finally about to pay off, the truth explodes in her face: the daughter she’s tormented and belittled all along… is her own blood.
6aa75787742a9765a10bfc80.title: She Swapped the Wrong Baby

6aa8dad9632d51a1f901d837.synopsis: Elara thought the worst thing that could happen was getting pregnant by a dangerous stranger. She was wrong. Because the man hunting her down is Silas Thorne, New York's most feared mafia don. And he isn't just the father of her baby. He's her boyfriend's father. Now Silas wants her under his roof, his son wants her back, and the Thorne family is one secret away from tearing itself apart. Elara only made one mistake that night. But in this family, one mistake can start a war.
6aa8dad9632d51a1f901d837.title: Pregnant by My Ex's Father

6aa9f3cd0cf84de170032bc9.synopsis: Grayson, hidden ruler of the Five Nation Syndicate, poses as a gardener. His wife Vanessa leaves him for being poor and falls for Ivan — his most dangerous subordinate plotting to seize the vault. Grayson infiltrates his own summit, proving his identity through golden keys and escalating confrontations. Outgunned, he flees with waitress Sarah and discovers she, not Vanessa, once saved his life. He turns Ivan's heist into a trap, ambushes the traitors in the vault, and crowns Sarah as queen.
6aa9f3cd0cf84de170032bc9.title: Five Keys, One Hidden King

6aad0b798f6a7e56ac09c191.synopsis: Tessa was supposed to be graduating college. Instead, she wakes up trapped inside Vampire Academy, a survival horror game where dying means never making it back to the real world. Her only advantage? A dating system that keeps ordering her straight into the arms of Nolan Grave, the deadliest vampire in the game. Kiss him. Bite him. Get into his bed. Every task keeps her alive. Every touch makes him hungrier. But when the other vampires come for her, Nolan is always the one who stops them. So what does he really want? To protect her? Or to make sure no one else gets a taste before he does?
6aad0b798f6a7e56ac09c191.title: Kiss the Vampire or Die

6aaf3aa4bdadc9280a004fa7.synopsis: Scholarship student Abbi is bullied by Felix at Camden Prep, yet poverty forces her into his home as live-in nanny. Hatred turns to desire: Felix confesses cruelty masked attraction; Abbi sees his protective side. But his abusive father Scott forbids romance on pain of dismissal. Braving blackmail, viral humiliation, and a rival's sabotage, they love in secret. Felix uses years of recorded abuse evidence to banish Scott, freeing them both. Abbi earns Oxford and Head Girl, enemies become lovers.
6aaf3aa4bdadc9280a004fa7.title: Nanny to the Boy Who Hates Me

6aaf6c6449315e6453090bd9.synopsis: Caterina thought a proposal to marry the Duke's son, Felton, would save her poor family. But the night before her debut ball, her bed is pillaged by Augustus, who brands her with his crest. Dishonored overnight, Caterina heads to her debut, hoping Felton will claim her love. But her world spirals when she realizes the man who's laid claim to her is the wicked Duke, and her fiancé's father.
6aaf6c6449315e6453090bd9.title: Marked by My Duke Daddy

6ab3b0f68eb57767b80f5732.synopsis: Claire, an ordinary waitress, happens to rescue a little girl named Ava who has been hurt. Billionaire Lucas, seeking to comfort his traumatized daughter, signs a six-month contract marriage with Claire. Entering the lavish Grant estate, Claire heals Ava and also changes the cold, distant Lucas. Facing the family's hostility, the exposure of the contract, and one conspiracy after another, the three break through the shackles of money and blood ties — proving that a true family is made of people who choose one another willingly.
6ab3b0f68eb57767b80f5732.title: The Billionaire’s Daughter Chose Me to Be Her Mommy
